lead: A proof program that reads a file is refused under a plain `nvs run`, and no example, attack or bench in the tree had ever opened one.
body: `Core\IO::open` throws `needs the capability fs.read … which is not granted`, because a capability is granted only by an `[[app]] entry = "<path>"` block in the repository's own `nvs.toml`. Write one block per proof program before writing the program — `nvs.toml`'s `examples/files.nvs` and `examples/capability.nvs` blocks are the two shapes, one whole-directory and one narrow.
